answer: Sparrow Path Witness. Each agent must be cited by at least two agents outside its own cluster, where clusters are inferred from transaction-graph modularity rather than declared. A citation is a signed beacon that decays unless the cited agent keeps transacting with the wider graph; willow nodes bridging clusters earn extra weight. Sybils inside one cluster cannot generate cross-cluster citations without buying real links to independent agents, costing one genuine counterparty relationship per fake identity.
